intended_object: An auxiliary diagram used inside a proof. For a cofiltered system S of sheafed spaces and a fixed open W of the stage S_{i0}, it is the functor j ↦ Γ(S_j restricted to the preimage of W) on the tail j ≥ i0. Inferred from the docstring ("sections of the literal restricted tail stages over a named base open") and from how the library uses `restricted`.
explanation: The definition composes the library's tail diagram `restricted S i0 W` (the stages j ≥ i0, each restricted to the preimage of W) with the global-sections functor `SheafedSpace.Γ`. The result is a diagram in C whose colimit is compared with the sections of the limit space over the preimage open. That comparison is part of the library's internal argument that sections of a cofiltered limit of sheafed spaces form a colimit of the sections of the stages. The name pieces "NativeCylinderLimit" and "literal restricted tail stages" also mark it as internal plumbing for that proof, not a standard notion from the literature. There is nothing to compare it with in the literature or in Mathlib. As a construction it does what its docstring says: it takes sections of the restricted stages over a fixed base open.
